limitations: The business authorization database was isolated SQLite and the OpenShell CLI upload/install operations were deterministic test doubles; no live Qwen sandbox was used in this proof.
The callback factory is callable but is not installed in a formal periodic supervisor or wired to business start/stop and recovery.
Revocation is observed at the next tick; this test does not prove immediate broker withdrawal at the moment the grant is revoked.
SIQ Org IAM integration, production PostgreSQL migration, positive Qwen model inference, and Hermes gateway business-tool dispatch remain unverified.
